## Tanzania safaris

- [All safaris](https://smickzanzibar.com/safaris): Mikumi and Nyerere day trips from Zanzibar ($430+), Serengeti fly-in safaris ($1,676+), Tarangire & Ngorongoro 2 days ($526+), 5–10 day northern circuit safaris.

## Other services

- [Holiday packages](https://smickzanzibar.com/packages): 3 to 10 day Zanzibar packages with hotel, meals, transfers and excursions ($390+).
- [Transfers](https://smickzanzibar.com/transfers): airport/ferry to Stone Town $15, Paje/Jambiani $40, Nungwi/Kendwa $80 (per vehicle).
